assayList.name: Thyroid Bioactivity
assayList.description: Assays related to the thyroid adverse outcome pathway network

response.assayComponentEndpointDesc: Data from the assay component CCTE_Deisenroth_TSHR_2D_Ag_CTOX was analyzed at the assay endpoint, CCTE_Deisenroth_TSHR_2D_Ag_CTOX_ATP, bidirectionally relative to DMSO as the negative control and baseline of activity. Using a type of ATP, loss-of-signal activity can be used to understand changes in thyroid stimulating hormone receptor agonism for thyroglobulin synthesis. To generalize the intended target to other relatable targets, this assay endpoint is annotated to the cell cycle intended target family, where the subfamily is cytotoxicity.
response.assayComponentDesc: CCTE_Deisenroth_TSHR_2D_Ag_CTOX is an assay component calculated from the assay. It is designed to measure cell death using a type of viability reporter as detected by luminescence intensity with CellTiter-Glo 2.0 technology.
response.assayComponentTargetDesc: Changes in luminescence produced from the viability reporter involving the key reagent, luciferin, are indicative of changes in cellular ATP as a determinant for cytotoxicity.
response.assayDesc: CCTE_Deisenroth_TSHR_2D_Agonist is a cell-based, single-readout assay that uses human primary thyrocytes. Measurements were taken 96 hours after repeated chemical dosing in a 96-well plate.
response.assaySourceDesc: The Deisenroth laboratory at the EPA Center for Computational Toxicology and Exposure focuses on developing in vitro methods investigating endocrine disruption and developmental toxicity, as well as assays incorporating xenobiotic metabolism.
